reviews.comment: Dr Khraisheh is a wonderful professor. There were 2 readings per week, which varied in length but were always very manageable. Two unexcused absences throughout the semester, but usually very understanding if you have a valid reason. Would recommend this class Dr Khraisheh is a very good lecturer! No tests but pop reading reflections, really easy.

Great professor, it was her first year teaching and I learned so much in this class. I understand that she was new so at times I could tell that she was nervous. I can see her being a top teir professor in the future. 10/10 professor!
